name: zclass_cls_di_find_best_pick_candidate_below_point
description: zClass_cls_di::FindBestPickCandidateBelowPoint builds point-query candidates and reduces them to the best candidate at or below the query height.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this helper; tier S verification is deferred to the zClass DI/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x443c70 validates ECX as world, EDX as query position, stack outResults, BuildPickCandidateListBelowPoint(world, outResults, position.x, position.y, position.z), no-candidate handling that zeroes candidateCount and clears entries[0].variantTag, candidate reduction over 0x28-byte entries, selection of the highest hitPos.y not above position.y, tie handling that prefers a tagged candidate when the current best has empty variantTag, copying the selected 0x28-byte entry to entries[0], and setting candidateCount to 1.

The native smoke uses the real point-query builder to produce multiple candidates, verifies selection of the highest below-query candidate and variant payload preservation, and verifies the no-candidate path clears the first result variant tag.
